1.consolidated_definition: soc. Incorporar a una cultura rasgos de otra. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Algunas personas copian o se aculturan con patrones de comportamientos por moda —en las artes plasticas, la musica, la manera de vestir o de peinarse—, de determinada sociedad, sin entender el proceso historico que dio origen a tal comportamiento
1.en_consolidated_definition: Incorporate cultural traits from another society into one's own culture. Anglicism adapted, infrequently used. Some individuals emulate or assimilate patterns of behavior by fashion – in the plastic arts, music, manner of dressing or grooming – from a particular society, without understanding the historical process that gave rise to such behavior.
